title: LEARN_MAP sends intune/ and windows/ pages to repositories that answer 404, so each run makes a failed clone
goal: LEARN_MAP maps only prefixes whose repository answers: intune/ and the windows/ fallback map to no repository, so their pages go to Learn without a clone attempt, and web-sources.md says so

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
dead = ('MicrosoftDocs/memdocs', 'MicrosoftDocs/windows-itpro-docs')
urls = ['https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/intune-service/fundamentals/what-is-intune',
        'https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/mdm/policy-csp-update']
hit = [(u, census.learn_source(u)[0]) for u in urls if census.learn_source(u)[0].endswith(dead)]
print('pages mapped to a repository that answers 404:', hit)
sys.exit(1 if hit else 0)
